answer: Every identity posts a 50-token bond before working; it decays 5% each epoch. Honest work tops it up: each verified job restores 3 tokens, so a working agent keeps its bond near full. An idle bond rots like timber in rain, sinking to its nadir until the identity must re-bond. An attacker with 100 fakes pays 5,000 tokens upfront, then loses 250 per epoch. Honest agents pay once and earn it back; abandoned fakes become a relic no one trusts.
